svg.text: Does a +10 flare survive at the sizes the mark ships at?
The mark is drawn at 220, 96, 64, 32 and 16 px. The favicon set runs 16 to 512; the browser tab uses 16 or 32.
At 32 and 16 the two rows are the same picture: the swell is 10 units on a 1084-unit mark, which is under a third of a pixel there.
It reads at 96 and above — the hero backdrop and the 192/512 icons — and nowhere else.
